_comment: Intentional deltas from the committed baseline. Adding a property here means 'this route's property is EXPECTED to differ from the baseline', which switches that invariant OFF for that route. Keep it small, and prune it whenever the baseline is re-captured — an entry that outlives the change it describes is a disabled check nobody remembers disabling.
_pruned_2026_08_27: Emptied after re-capturing against prod at 609d8de. It had reached 67 of 96 routes: title accepted on 54 and jsonLdTypes on 53, from the SEO pass (hidden-div removal, prerendered JSON-LD, case-study titles) plus the older /about-us -> /careers move. Every entry was correct when written and every one of those changes is now in prod-baseline.json, so the invariants guard the new values instead of being switched off.
